mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market that typically precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and HOUST on 60-day SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on 20-day SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of early-cycle expansion periods when RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
